Carrying over an open point from #324 ([original thread](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/pull/324#discussion_r3687655828)).

@trask found that `data_points` has no `skip_serializing_if`, so the key is always present and `null` when a metric has no data set — which kills the marker branch, the dict branch and the `metric["data"]` lookup, and leaves `null` falling into the catch-all where a valid Weaver serialization gets logged as invalid.

Applied his suggestion as-is in cd07fc2, plus the `test_null_data_points_is_skipped_without_warning` case he wrote — it fails on the old function with the warning he quoted and passes after. Verified against the Weaver this branch pins, v0.25.1.

One deviation: the test uses a local log-capture helper instead of `caplog`, so it also runs under `python tests/test_metrics.py`. CI doesn't run `reference/tests/` today, so that path is the only one that executes it.

This is missing anthropic. #324 landed on main after this PR's last CI run, so the green anthropic check is stale — the anthropic scenario now goes through `opentelemetry-util-genai`, which records the duration histogram on every inference invocation and token usage whenever token counts are set, as that scenario does. On a rebase, `run-scenario anthropic` will produce a `metrics` block in `scenarios/anthropic/data.json` and the up-to-date check will fail.

Worth doing beyond the CI fix: anthropic is the only library here that passes `server_port`, so both new report pages currently show `server.port | (none)` when they shouldn't. Please rebase on main and re-run `uv run run-scenario anthropic` plus `uv run update-reports`.

threads.body:
Should google-adk be credited with these? ADK records both metrics for the model call it delegates to `google-genai` — the same call whose inference span #351 removed and whose README row says "correctly not emitted". `_suppress_adk_native_tracing` only patches tracers and the `trace_*` helpers, so ADK's own metrics pass through.

Is that intended, or should the suppression cover the metrics too?

replies.body:
Neither, I think — it's a conditional fallback.

ADK emits them itself (meter scope `gcp.vertex.agent`; `google/genai/` has no OTel code at all), but the attributes describe the delegated call: `gen_ai.operation.name = generate_content`, `gen_ai.provider.name = gemini`.

And ADK treats them as model-client telemetry. `_should_emit_native_telemetry` returns False when the google-genai instrumentation is active on a Gemini agent, "then the lib already emits inference metrics" — so ADK only emits these when no real client instrumentation is present.

That leaves the span and the metric disagreeing about the same call: one says "delegates, correctly not emitted", the other credits google-adk. I'd rather close that on the suppression side — the helper already patches the tracers and the `trace_*` helpers, so covering the meter is the same kind of change.

Happy to do it here or leave it for a separate change, whichever you prefer.
sounds good, let's do it here, thanks

@trask done in 17402e9. The two client instruments are now disabled alongside the tracers, and the invoke_agent counters are untouched.

The scenario README already said inference here is "correctly not emitted". That was only true of spans until now.
